# sonarqube_project_main_branch (Resource)

The name of a project's main branch. If a branch with that name exists, it becomes the main branch; otherwise the main branch is renamed. Destroying it leaves the branch as it is. Import ID: `project/name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_project_main_branch" "api" {
  project = "example-api"
  name    = "main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Main branch name.
- `project` (String) Project key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_project_main_branch.example 'example-api/main'
```
